message.content: {"title":"Ethics Report Rubric","total":null,"criteria":[{"id":"C1","name":"Introduction — Identifies ethical issues and broad links to engineering design; discusses the context of ethical issues in engineering organisations; identifies relevant stakeholders when considering the ethical issues.","weight":20,"max":10,"levels":[{"label":"Excellent","min":10,"max":10,"desc":"Several ethical issues and their significance identified, described, in the context of engineering design, understanding of BOTH context in engineering organisations and stakeholder interest is demonstrated."},{"label":"Very good","min":8,"max":8,"desc":"Several ethical issues identified, described, and linked to engineering design, understanding of context in engineering organisations OR stakeholder interest is demonstrated."},{"label":"Good","min":6,"max":6,"desc":"Few ethical issues identified, described, and linked to engineering design, but understanding of context and stakeholders is limited."},{"label":"Satisfactory","min":4,"max":4,"desc":"Few ethical issues identified and described, but the context and stakeholders are not identified."},{"label":"None","min":0,"max":0,"desc":"No ethical issues identified."}]},{"id":"C2","name":"Balanced Discussion — Discusses objective arguments for and against decisions on the ethical issues; draws a conclusion on how stakeholders should make decisions about the issues.","weight":20,"max":10,"levels":[{"label":"Excellent","min":10,"max":10,"desc":"Objective arguments are made with significant depth, leading to conclusions on decision making recommendations for several different stakeholders."},{"label":"Very good","min":8,"max":8,"desc":"Objective arguments are made with appropriate depth. Conclusions are made on decision making, though lack of consideration of different stakeholders."},{"label":"Good","min":6,"max":6,"desc":"Arguments are made, though they lack depth or are based on personal opinion. Conclusions are made on decision making, though lack of consideration of different stakeholders."},{"label":"Satisfactory","min":4,"max":4,"desc":"Ideas are presented, though they lack the depth required to build arguments. Conclusion is made with no apparent link to the arguments."},{"label":"None","min":0,"max":0,"desc":"No arguments presented. No conclusions drawn."}]},{"id":"C3","name":"Compelling Argument that supports conclusion — The report forms a compelling argument that justifies the conclusion; the body follows a logical structure, with linked paragraphs and content ordered to support the argument; arguments demonstrate a systematic understanding of the ethical issues for all stakeholders.","weight":20,"max":10,"levels":[{"label":"Excellent","min":10,"max":10,"desc":"Arguments are compelling, supported by the report structure. The conclusion is well supported by the arguments. The arguments demonstrate a systematic understanding of the ethical issues for all stakeholders."},{"label":"Very good","min":8,"max":8,"desc":"Arguments are compelling, supported by the report structure. The arguments support the conclusion, demonstrating a sound understanding of ethical issues."},{"label":"Good","min":6,"max":6,"desc":"Arguments are logically structured, though are not compelling. Conclusion is not well supported by the arguments presented."},{"label":"Satisfactory","min":4,"max":4,"desc":"Arguments are difficult to follow. Link to conclusion is unclear."},{"label":"None","min":0,"max":0,"desc":"Arguments are not evident. No conclusions drawn."}]},{"id":"C4","name":"Research and Evidence — Arguments are substantiated with adequate references and qualitative/quantitative evidence; research demonstrates a balanced, in-depth understanding of the topic.","weight":20,"max":10,"levels":[{"label":"Excellent","min":10,"max":10,"desc":"Arguments are well substantiated with references as well as both qualitative and quantitative evidence. Evidence of research demonstrates a balanced and in-depth understanding of the topic and its ethical issues."},{"label":"Very good","min":8,"max":8,"desc":"Arguments are substantiated with adequate references and some qualitative/quantitative evidence. Research demonstrates a good understanding of the topic."},{"label":"Good","min":6,"max":6,"desc":"Arguments are substantiated with some relevant references and qualitative OR quantitative evidence. Research demonstrates a moderate understanding of the topic."},{"label":"Satisfactory","min":4,"max":4,"desc":"Limited references that lack relevance to arguments, showing limited evidence of research."},{"label":"None","min":0,"max":0,"desc":"No references, or other evidence of research to support arguments."}]},{"id":"C5","name":"Report Structure, Format and Language — The report includes appropriate sections serving their functions (abstract, introduction, body, and conclusion); maps, figures, tables, and visual elements are correctly used to support discussion; writing is grammatically correct, fluent, concise, easy to read and understand, and uses appropriate word choice; references are well-structured and appropriate, supporting the report’s motivations.","weight":20,"max":10,"levels":[{"label":"Excellent","min":10,"max":10,"desc":"The report is fluently written, has no incorrect uses of language, uses several types of visual elements competently, and uses relevant references extensively."},{"label":"Very good","min":8,"max":8,"desc":"The report is fluently written, has no incorrect uses of language, uses several types of visual elements competently, and uses relevant references."},{"label":"Good","min":6,"max":6,"desc":"The report is fluently written, has no incorrect uses of language, uses limited visual elements, and a few relevant references."},{"label":"Satisfactory","min":4,"max":4,"desc":"The report is fluently written, has few incorrect uses of language, very limited visual elements, and few, mostly irrelevant references."},{"label":"None","min":0,"max":0,"desc":"The report has incorrect uses of language, has no visual elements, expression is not fluent, and references are missing."}]}],"notes":""}
